title: Reachability: UEV (Earth and Earth orbit, then Alpha Centauri AB and Barnard b, then Sirius B)
note: UEV-C1 (docs/eras/uev.md "Validator", "Gate to UIV"): UHV's pack plus the 25 UEV machines, the three trips, the UEV wireless tier and the checks of the Validator. Substages: uev (Earth and Earth orbit), uev-alpha and uev-barnard (parallel siblings after the DFD Mk1), uev-sirius (after uev-barnard). TP-V (as built after the tier-parity retrofit, as uxv.json:7): gtceu:uev_field_generator is made only in the Sirius works (tables/sirius.json:42), so the Mk4 (3 of them, uev/fusion.js:78) is checked in uev-sirius; the UEV assembly line rows (7,864,320 EU/t, TP-R-uev) get @uev2 and the UEV assembler rows two-UHV-hatch UAF @uev2; the warp gate site list has the two UXV ends.

After TP-INT the UEV hatch takes gtceu:uev_field_generator, made only in the Sirius works (tables/sirius.json:42), so the one-UEV-hatch large assembler alone would make the Sirius casings wait for Sirius.
